hints.r-cmd-check.yaml: open the failed job's log at the step named, fix the first error, warning or note it lists, and push again. R CMD check counts a note as a failure.
hints.coverage.yaml: the tests cover less of the code than the limit in DESCRIPTION: add tests for the lines this pull request adds, listed above.
hints.full-tests.yaml: the failing tests are listed above, with their messages. Run them on your computer with devtools::test().
hints.no-suggests.yaml: code, examples or vignettes use a package from Suggests without checking it is installed: guard each use with rlang::is_installed() or requireNamespace().
hints.secret-scan.yaml: remove the secret, and replace it wherever it is used (a new password or key): removing it in a later commit leaves it in the history, where anyone can read it.
hints.lint.yaml: run the quality gate's lint mode on your computer and fix what it lists; Air and the spelling word list can fix most of it for you.
